text: What keeps the operator honest is the relationship premium — the value of staying over leaving, composed of future earnings, standing, and the cost of starting over; the stake enters the fixed capacity identities only through the recovery wedges.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Refundable Stake Does Not Expand Deterrent Capacity in Long-Lived Delegation: Collateral, Premia, and Pseudonymous Markets (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7322599

isBasedOn.name: Refundable Stake Does Not Expand Deterrent Capacity in Long-Lived Delegation: Collateral, Premia, and Pseudonymous Markets

abstract: What keeps the operator honest is the value of the relationship itself: the premium P of staying over leaving, composed of future earnings, standing, and the cost of starting over. The stake F enters these fixed- (P, F ) identities only through the recovery wedges.
